reviews.title: Bra review
reviews.review_text: I ordered a black Smooth U Posture bra, and a nude colored one. The black one is awesome, but the other not so much. The front hooks do not stay hooked. When I was at work the other day, I had to keep going into the ladies room, to refasten the top 4 hooks, as they kept undoing with movement.

reviews.title: Not a perfect fit.
reviews.review_text: The bottom of the cups fit and the middle but the top I don't fill out at all. I will need to get push ups and that should do it. All in all I', not that happy with this bra and will not buy it again. I've been wearing Bali bras for decades and love them. they have always been a perfect fit before.

reviews.title: Doesn't seem to follow Bali sizing.
reviews.review_text: I bought some comfort revolution front close bras in 42c. I bought this bra in 42c in both colors. I could barely get it on, definitely could not close it. Was like it was 2 sizes too small. I checked, it was 42c Bummer, I was really looking forward to it. Had to return them. :(

reviews.title: Bad fabric
reviews.review_text: I had high hopes for this bra. I like the idea of it but unfortunately the fabric in front near the closure rubs my skin raw. I've washed it and tried to remove any protruding parts but it's just to scratchy of a fabric to have close to your skin. I won't be buying it again.

reviews.title: Don't buy
reviews.review_text: After one wash the fabric falls off. The fabric glue that they use does not work. I put it through one wash and the bra has completely fallen apart. Not to mention the wire is flimsy and after a wash it snapped in half.

reviews.title: Picture was better than reality
reviews.review_text: This bra is made of the oddest material. the straps aren't adjustable and in warm weather it feels like you're wearing plastic wrap. I had high hopes for this bra but it's a complete disappointment.

reviews.title: Disappointing.
reviews.review_text: It was very hard to get into even though it is front closing. The back smoothing aspect did not function as promised. It really wasn't the quality that I expected.

reviews.title: Not comfortable
reviews.review_text: Cups too big, straps too tight and short and not adjustable. Bra doesn't come down far enough, sits on chest too high and straps are fixed. Bra is stiff and not comfortable.

reviews.title: Did not like
reviews.review_text: Not as described. I am 190 lbs. 42C and it did not cover the sides like it said it would on the show. They should use real heavy models so we know how it will really look.

reviews.title: Another great design poorly executed
reviews.review_text: Wore it once and the straps started separating. Fit was good - the corners they cut to save cost ruined it. I'd pay a LOT of money for a qelk made, well designed bra. Can't seem to find one. Anywhere....

reviews.title: Posture Boost
reviews.review_text: Had high hopes, but didn't get the right fit, and didn't feel the straps were doing anything for my posture. Don't understand, if most of the support comes from the band, why doesn't someone design a wider, 4-clasp band?

reviews.title: Size seems small.
reviews.review_text: I usually love this bra, ordered 3 the same size as my old ones. Going to have to say that they are slightly smaller, especially in the cup size. I'm sad because this has been my go to bra.

reviews.title: Workmanship
reviews.review_text: The bras do not stay clipped closed. It unlatches and the only clip that stays latched is the 4 clip next to the body. I would like to receive a refund.

reviews.title: HORRIBLE
reviews.review_text: The bra was terrible. It was difficult to get on. The size must be precise because there is only one row of closures. Once on it felt like a tight corset. It physically hurt to wear it.

reviews.title: Not good
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this bra but I don't. Every time I bend over the back goes way up and I have to yank it back down. The closures on the front are difficult and sometimes come undone. It's comfortable when it perfectly in place and I would love it if it would stay there. But it won't.

reviews.title: Love, Hate
reviews.review_text: I love the feel of this bra. The shoulder straps don't cut in to my shoulders. But...as I was at church game night last night, one of the underwires came poking out of the bra and heading toward my neck. It had torn through and was coming out after I had the bra for only a week or so. I have tried to mend it but will see if it continues to come out. This bra is not well enough made if it only last such a short time without tearing. It has been washed only once.

reviews.title: Runs small
reviews.review_text: I ordered my regular size and the band was so tight I could barely fasten it. Still I wore it all day figuring it might loosen with wearing. That was a mistake I paid for for the next few days. I would recommend going up at least one size if you want to give this a try. Also note the straps are not adjustable at all.

reviews.title: Posture Boost Bra
reviews.review_text: The bra is made well; however, I need something more adjustable. The straps just aren't long enough for me. You have to wear it right up under your arm pits to smooth out any fat you may have and that's not a comfortable fit for me. It does help with your posture. It's just not for me.

reviews.title: Rubbed me the wrong way
reviews.review_text: The band rubbed my heart surgery scar and I just couldn't keep them. Return was easy. I liked the front closure so I gave the bras 2 stars. I have other front closure Bali bras that were much more forgiving around the chest area. Seems like they stiffened it up a little. I couldn't tolerate the roughness against my skin.

reviews.title: Not happy with my purchase
reviews.review_text: These bras are not at all what I expected and I wouldn't recommend them.

reviews.title: Not for me!
reviews.review_text: The fabric this is made of does not support big busted women. The idea is good; its the execution that is lacking. Putting it on is a struggle.

reviews.title: It's kind of tight I'd go a size up
reviews.review_text: I should've went to size up now I have to go on a diet because the band is really tight and I always wear a 42D

reviews.title: Smooth U posture bra
reviews.review_text: Very disappointed. Fit is horrible, this is the first time I have ever been disappointed with a Bali Bra.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.review_text: The bra did not deliver as anticipated. There was no real support under the arm. Did not anticipate not being able to adjust shoulder straps would be so uncomfortable. Definitely returning these.

reviews.title: Bra doesn't come in size 34
reviews.review_text: Nice bra but should come in34 D

reviews.title: Terrible fitting brad
reviews.review_text: The bra is loose fitting even on the last set of hooks. It appears that they were previously worn, returned, and resold. I'm extremely unsatisfied with all 5 bras that I ordered.

reviews.title: Hated!
reviews.review_text: I was really hoping to love this bra, but alas I hated it! The hooks were very hard to fasten, the underwire was too wide, and the back did next to nothing to help my posture. Sadly, I had to return them.

reviews.title: Way to small
reviews.review_text: I had to return it. I bought the size I wear from other companies and I was about 6 inches away from getting it around me. If your ordering one buy it several sizes larger that you need:

reviews.title: Not Comfortable
reviews.review_text: Bought the same size as my other Bali bras but this one is too loose and won't lie flat against the skin. It rides up in the back and rubs under my arms. Very uncomfortable. The four hook front closure doesn't stay secure either, At least two hooks come undone. Sorry I bought it.

reviews.title: No quite right
reviews.review_text: The front clasp is to long and the top hooks come undone easily. Have worn for a few weeks now and the straps have worn through on the inside edge and bonding is rubbing out. I like the fit and feel but still needs work on durability of the material.

reviews.title: Not fit
reviews.review_text: They just did not fit me comfortably. I have not received my refund yet, either.

reviews.title: Do not buy
reviews.review_text: This bra cannot be adjusted at all. It's hard to explain. I do not recommend buying this product

reviews.title: Great but…
reviews.review_text: Love the fit and comfort support is great but the bottom hook comes undone every time i wear it and pokes me so annoying

reviews.title: Size
reviews.review_text: I found this bra small in size, hard to even try on. I felt like I was putting a straght jacket on. Sent back.

reviews.title: Posture No Boost
reviews.review_text: The underwire is not comfortable and the front closure does not pull in enough to accomplishe the goals.

reviews.title: Zero Stars
reviews.review_text: Very poor quality. Terribly uncomfortable. I took the underwire out hoping it would help. Then I threw it in the trash.

reviews.title: Not my favorite
reviews.review_text: The back did not provide any additional support. The front closure digs in to me and is very uncomfortable.

reviews.title: Uncomfortable
reviews.review_text: The bra was very uncomfortable. The straps were too short which caused the back to ride up to unbearable level. The cups couldn't be where they needed to be and caused gaps.

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.review_text: The straps are not adjustable, and they're much too short. The bra feels like I'm wearing a tourniquet. It keeps riding up and feels like it gets tighter and tighter. Hate it!

reviews.title: Flaw in design
reviews.review_text: Get idea for back support, however; there are no adjustment clips and once straps stretch there is no way to tighten support. Also, front hooks can become a rubbing problem.

reviews.title: Wanted to love it
reviews.review_text: I wanted to like this but it just doesn't fit the way I think it should. Straps are not adjustable and it seems to come unhooked in the front without warning.

reviews.title: Not true to size and quality questionable.....
reviews.review_text: Not even close to a true size. Runs way to small. Very disappointed. Especially for as long as I had to wait for them to be delivered. I am returning for a full refund

reviews.title: Not comfortable
reviews.review_text: This bra is not for big breast women it give no support.This bra allows to much bouncing around and very little support,it hurts where the closure is it turns upside down and digs into the skin.

reviews.title: posture boost bra
reviews.review_text: it's just o.k. the hooks in front don't stay hooked (top ones) and the straps are too long for me. I'm not very tall. Just not as impressed as I expected to be

reviews.title: Irritating and uncomfortable
reviews.review_text: Although the back is comfortable, the sides dig in under the arms and rub the skin with movement. I love Bali, but this design is a flop in my opinion.

reviews.title: The back fit isn't great
reviews.review_text: The idea and front of this bra is very nice. The back is not. The back is unfinished and sloppy with gapping. I feel over time we gals will get a good bra in this style. It not quite yet-:(

reviews.title: Needs some revision
reviews.review_text: I only gave this 2 stars because it's a great idea, and it IS helpful as a posture reminder. However, the front closure was not well thought out. As it is, there is a great deal of friction - enough so that I was left with an unpleasant abrasion, and I am not a large person. There is little padding between the hooks and the body, and it is very close to the edge. I really wanted this to work well for me, but I'm inclined to believe this is a problem many, if not most, people would have.

reviews.title: Not a good fit
reviews.review_text: Unfortunately I will be returning. Could hardly get the hooks closed and when I finally did the straps were too short and I couldn't get the bra down enough to cover (stay covered) my boobs. Was so hoping these would fit as i love Bali and have worn for years. Just wanted something different.

reviews.title: In like but not in love
reviews.review_text: I wanted to love this bra because I love Bali. Unfortunately there are a couple things that make it less than stellar. The front hooks are hard to hook with the hardware so close to the hooks. First try took me s good 5 minutes. There's no strap adjustment and I have a short torso. Lastly, Do not believe the hype that spandex is cool and comfy. It's not. It doesn't breathe. Regardless, I do like the wide straps and the cup fit is pretty good. I'm a 38D and this definitely provides noticeable lift. Luckily I got these at a great price so I'll be keeping them.

reviews.title: Falling apart at the seams
reviews.review_text: Getting the right fit might be tricky (had to size up) but I was really liking this bra until the front strap material started to peel apart revealing very thin and cheap white elastic! Never seen a bra fall apart like this. What a shame as I liked it so much at first that I bought two.

reviews.title: Bali One Smooth U Posture Support Bra
reviews.review_text: Not well made. No seams and I do not feel this will wash or wear nicely. I feel that that material will begin to fray after washing and wearing. I am disappointed as I have always like the quality and fit of Bali bras. I would not recommend this product and seriously thought of sending it back.

reviews.title: Great product destroyed by cheap confection.
reviews.review_text: To: BALI BRA, WHY DESTROY SUCH AMAZING PRODUCT? I purchased this bra a few years ago for the first time, and it was amazing back then. It was sewn all the way around. Now it's glued, and the fabric is thinner, so it stretches faster. The support around the breast does not sit the same way. I was so impressed the first time I purchased 4 more second time around was a disaster. Searching for alternatives because this bra is not the same anymore.

reviews.title: Wish it would have worked
reviews.review_text: The cups fit nicely but the straps are too wide for someone who is petite. The front closure was also too long for my short frame. If it had a smaller front closure and thinner adjustable straps I would have loved it. Unfortunately, I'm not using it and it's in the drawer with all the rest of the sad endings. Not Bali's fault, I'm big chested and petite. Hard to find a comfortable bra.

reviews.title: Need more than comfort
reviews.review_text: Not only was it difficult to hook, it also unhooked with movement. The front hooks would be ok for someone who did not have excess weight in the midsection as it digs unless your standing. The material is too soft & flimsy to claim the category of a ‘posture boost' bra.

reviews.title: Good idea but it didn't work.
reviews.review_text: Was really disappointed. It rides up in the back, straps migrate closer and closer to my neck the longer I wore it. It pooched out on the sides under my arms and irritated me. Concept was good but fabric wasn't strong enough to give any support. Bad choice for mr.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.review_text: I have been very pleased with Bali bras for many years and was really excited to find the website! However, I found the Posture Boost/Ever Smooth Back bra comfortable enough but it did not really give me any support. The underwire helped a bit but since the straps aren't adjustable in any way, I found I couldn't adjust to my needs. And perhaps I should have ordered a 34" versus a 36", as there wasn't enough support to keep the bra from slipping forward and downward. This is the only bra from Bali that I've been disappointed in.

reviews.title: Baggie Cups
reviews.review_text: Great bra if it fit right - the top of the cup does not sit flush with my body as my other Bali bras do. It is the same size as my others. I bought 2 different styles and they both are baggie at the top of the cup, very visible thru my clothing that it does not fit right.

reviews.title: Returning this bra
reviews.review_text: I am not a big person but this bra runs so small I could not get it on. The shoulder straps were way to short and I could not get my arms through them.I also was unable to pull the bra down enough to fit into the cups. Did I get a defective or mismarked item? It was horrible! Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Not the bra for me
reviews.review_text: This bra did not fit me at all. The straps were too short and not adjustable. The sides were all the way up in my armpits. The cups were also too high. I had to pull myself up to fill the cups. The hooks on the front is a good idea, however, I wear glasses and cannot see what I am doing because when looking down I am looking below the actual glasses. It took me about 5 minutes to get this bra on and get myself into it. The fabric choice was not my favorite but was less important than the fit issues. Sadly, I will be returning them.

reviews.title: Poor fit
reviews.review_text: Be very careful. I ordered the size that they said would sent me and it was awful. Too small, struggled to get it on and then look like I was falling out all over the place. I would not recommend this bra at all and less you have purchased it before and know your size.

reviews.title: This one is a NO.
reviews.review_text: While I hate to give a bad review, this time I have to. This has to be the worst bra I ever purchased, The fit is just weird. The cups come up so high that they are almost at your neck and it is not adjustable. I wanted it because it was a posture bra but it will be going back. My own fault, I should have listened to all the other negative reviews but I thought I'd give it a shot.

reviews.title: Not the perfect bra
reviews.review_text: This bra doesn't have much give anywhere. The cup edges are really stiff, and it doesn't like to stay closed. Even though it does seem to fit and nothing bulges, the eye hooks down the front like to come undone if I move around too much. I do like how wide the sides are and the straps don't fall because of the shape of the back.

reviews.title: Manufacturing defect
reviews.review_text: The bra does what it says it will do and that is help with back support. The problem with the bra, and i have 5 is that there is a wuality proble. Two of mine at the seams cane apart and i had to sew them back wher the seams had spkit open. Seems like a manufacturing defect.

reviews.title: Uncomfortable and cannot return
reviews.review_text: Very uncomfortable especially on the sides where it digs into my skin and underarm. I am 5"2.5' and I think that the bra is made for someone much taller. I should have checked the refund policy because I am now stuck with two bras and cannot return. I will never order bras online again. Must try them on first. I purchased this because I need back support for my sciatica and must try a supportive bra for 6 months before considering breast reduction surgery.

reviews.title: Don't buy it.
reviews.review_text: Wow this was a misser, esp for that price. It does not correct, it is just sewn very short in length, The material is too flimsy to correct. It just rides up to under your chin. Also the cups continue sideways too much and have the underwire poke your arm.

reviews.title: thin and poorly made
reviews.review_text: Isnt well made and isnt the same as the same brand and style at other stores.

reviews.title: Not viable!
reviews.review_text: Odd fit & construction. I bought something else!

reviews.title: No strap adjustment capability
reviews.review_text: No give in the straps which made it to tight.

reviews.title: straps
reviews.review_text: The straps are not adjustable making the bra unwearable.

reviews.title: New bra to small
reviews.review_text: To small for a 36 D. Can't fasten it!

reviews.title: Straps should be adjustable
reviews.review_text: The straps were too short and not adjustable, which made the bra ride up on me.

reviews.title: Fit tooooo tight
reviews.review_text: Too tight to put on.. I'm returning both/2 of them.. thank you

reviews.title: Sent back - still waiting for refund!
reviews.review_text: The bra did not fit so I sent it back. I still have not been refunded! Not happy!

reviews.title: Poorly constructed
reviews.review_text: I bought this bra 3 weeks ago and the band is already falling apart. The bottom of the band in the back has separated into two pieces that appear to have only been glued together, not sewn. I liked this bra. I found it comfortable and supportive and I am very disappointed by the construction.

reviews.title: Posture boost
reviews.review_text: I purchased one previously and the fit is fantastic. I purchased 2 more in a different color, same size, but the fit is so awful, I can't wear them.

reviews.title: Can't adjust straps
reviews.review_text: There was no way to adjust the straps. I have a longer torso so the bra doesn't sit properly . It didn't cover my breasts underneath.

reviews.title: Straps
reviews.review_text: The straps are not adjustable. This is a problem. It is a nice bra but it is not a good fit because of the straps.

reviews.title: Beware RUNS SMALL
reviews.review_text: Runs small! I've already worn so I can't return. I ordered the size I usually wear in Bali Bras and this thing chokes me - way too tight!

reviews.title: Posture bra
reviews.review_text: Fit me poorly and the straps were not adjustable. I normally love my bali bras but the posture one was not for me unfortunately.

reviews.title: too tight
reviews.review_text: for me, the cups were too roomy at the top,and the straps were not adjustable, which made the straps too tight. very uncomfortable.

reviews.title: Size not accurate
reviews.review_text: I do not care for this bra. I don't think it fits accurate to size. I was disappointed and wish it did what it promised.

reviews.title: Return
reviews.review_text: I returned because it was too small and not comfortable. You should have received last week Thursday. No refund to date

reviews.title: Not as claimed
reviews.review_text: I hate to complain but this bra was awful! The front clasp is tiny and difficult to fasten. It doesn't have enough substance to the material to even begin to live up to claims of “posture improvement”. And the straps are NOT adjustable.

reviews.title: Posture bra
reviews.review_text: I thought it was comfortable but I had a hard time fastening it. The section with the hooks were stiff and hard for me to hook it. I'm having difficulties with my hands now and thought a front hook would be easier.

reviews.title: Not a Fit
reviews.review_text: This bra was a strong possibility for my needs. There is no way of adjusting the straps. The front closure eye& hooks are difficult to manage. I will return both.

reviews.title: Keeps coming unhooked!
reviews.review_text: I can't wear this bra without the clasps unhooking with every move. I also wish the straps were adjustable, or just a little longer. Otherwise, the fit is good and it's comfortable.

reviews.title: Not enough support
reviews.review_text: I didn't like them. They're probably best for smaller busted women. I wear a 44D and they didn't give me the support I needed. The Material was kinda strange too.

reviews.title: Shorten the front closure strip!
reviews.review_text: I was ready to try something new, but the front closure on this bra is just too uncomfortable. It works fine while standing up, but when you sit down the front closure strip presses into the stomach.

reviews.title: Poor quality stitching
reviews.review_text: While the bra started out fine, it developed a tear in the stitching between the cup and strap after 3 wearings. I have always had great luck with Bali bras... disappointed that this one was so poorly made.

reviews.title: Poor Bra
reviews.review_text: Bra is too large and band size does not correspond to true size. Uncomfortable and bulky. Item was returned and am still waiting 2 weeks later for a refund.

reviews.title: A couple of issues
reviews.review_text: This does fit comfortably. My only complaints are the padding is not thick enough to keep things from poking through under thin tops and the top clasp comes undone easily.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.review_text: I ordered a 40 DD and this wouldn't even snap together in the front. It's more like 36 or 38. I ordered 2 other 40DD bras and they fit properly. Disappointed

reviews.title: Good bra but hard to fasten
reviews.review_text: Getting into this bra is a struggle. The front closure is extremely difficult to manage. Once on though, it definitely keeps your posture straight and is comfortable.

reviews.title: Luv and hate
reviews.review_text: I luv the way it fits abs feels and still have support. But the first 2 hooks keep coming undone. Whether I'm wearing it around the house or at work. The hooks constantly come undone. Disappointed in that.

reviews.title: Hard to put on
reviews.review_text: This doesn't smooth my back like I hoped it would. There's no way to adjust the straps, and it's very difficult to put on. Don't like the front closure. Glad I only ordered one!

reviews.title: Did not fit as well as it should have
reviews.review_text: This bra was not adjustable and even though it fit well on the sides, the straps were not adjustable in the front or back, and so it tended to ride up in the back

reviews.title: Sizing too small
reviews.review_text: The quality was great. However the sizing was not true-to-size. I ordered the same size I've gotten in the past from Bali, but this design was too small. I would suggest ordering up one chest and cup size.

reviews.title: Not just right for me
reviews.review_text: I like the style and fabrication. However, it rides up and there are no strap adjustments. Therefore the edges of the firmly padded cups irritate my armpits.

reviews.title: Poor Sizing
reviews.review_text: Why is the sizing so different from the exact same bra and size that I bought at the mall. Thought I could stock up because I love the bra, but I guess not.

reviews.title: Smaller than my other Balis in same size
reviews.review_text: These bras seem excellent, but are much too tight. I always buy Bali 38C, and after losing 15 pounds recently, this model in a 38C is very uncomfortably tight. Will return.

reviews.title: Really large!!
reviews.review_text: I ordered a 38C, then a 40C, now a 42C . . . The cups are all so friggin big!! Gappy, posture support is non-existant. Rides up my back!!! I gave it a three because they're so soft and I like to wear a bra to bed.

reviews.title: Not well made.
reviews.review_text: Unfortunately, I had to return this bra. The back is a flimsy plastic material that gives zero support to those who need posture correction. Also, the cup size is an awkward design that does not fit well.

reviews.title: Ouch?
reviews.review_text: Seems a little tight <sad> i went off my size for the LaceN Smooth (36D) however with the exception of the tightness my posture feels like it's correct

reviews.title: Not What It Appears to Be
reviews.review_text: I have felt no noticeable change in my posture from this bra. The sides have a gap that I will probably have to alter. While the fabric is fairly comfortable, the 4 hooks in the front are not. Overall, not what I'd expected.

reviews.title: Great bra, but...
reviews.review_text: Love this bra except the straps are too short for me. I was hoping the straps wouldn't be quite as short as they are, since I don't like my bra all up in my armpits. Since it has no adjustment there's not much I can do about it.

reviews.title: Not Happy
reviews.review_text: I could not wear the bras with the underwire. I had to take them out to be able to wear them. Then they seemed too loose and when I went to take it off on one hook was closed. So glad that one held on or it could have been very embaresing!!!

reviews.title: Side and back smoothing good: durability poor
reviews.review_text: While I like the shape this bra gives me and the front closure design, the smoothing panels are glued on and started coming apart after the first wash. Also, the straps do not adjust so the bra constantly rides up in the back.

reviews.title: Not so good.
reviews.review_text: Just recieved my Bra.. to which I was excited to try. Though the straps as some have stated which I wish I would of read reviews. Have no adjustments, and for me are to short. to which makes the underwiring ride up into my armpits. Other than that which.. makes it not to be a good choice in bra's. It might would be very comfortable. BUT NOT

reviews.title: Size is Way off. Runs super small
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Terrible design, definitely not true to size. I don't think it would even fit my Grand daughter. Supposedly 40C. Maybe a 34B. The material is terrible, reminds me of wet suit material. Definitely not a flattering bra.

reviews.title: Poor Quality
reviews.review_text: I purchased one of this style and found it very comfortable, so I decided to order several more. Big mistake. Even though all 3 were the same size, they each had a decidedly different fit. Then, after hand washing/drying several times, the straps fell apart (the glue holding them together disintegrated and they separated into two pieces.) I had really hoped that they would be as great as they were described. I had spinal surgery last year and needed a supportive bra. I am so disappointed in their quality!

reviews.title: Will I ever wear this?
reviews.review_text: Good in theory but execution is lacking

reviews.title: Faulty straps, feels cheap
reviews.review_text: The straps broke after the first use

reviews.title: No real benefit
reviews.review_text: Not a very strong fabric so not provide much posture correction or support.

reviews.title: Problem with sizing
reviews.review_text: Runs very very small for stated size. Will try to return.

reviews.title: Not a good fit
reviews.review_text: Not happy with the fit. Should have returned

reviews.title: Bra
reviews.review_text: Top snap doesn't stay closed. Didn't realize straps weren't adjustable.

reviews.title: Nicely made but straps are too short
reviews.review_text: The straps are not adjustable and too short on my particular body

reviews.title: Posture boost is wrong title
reviews.review_text: Elastic non adjustable band and straps, no support. Runs large. Returned couldn't use

reviews.title: Refund requested
reviews.review_text: Cups are way too large. Front hooks unsnap Repeatedly all day long.

reviews.title: Runs small
reviews.review_text: This type of bra didn't fit me at all. Ordered my size and was way too small!

reviews.title: Posture bra
reviews.review_text: Runs extremely small and the hook/eye closures are difficult to get to.

reviews.title: Not good quality
reviews.review_text: After one wear a hole appeared between the strap and the cup .

reviews.title: Terribly disappointed
